narr: Strong to severe thunderstorms erupted along a slow moving cold front over southern WI. Large hail, damaging winds, and flash flooding occurred. A lightning strike and subsequent fire caused significant damage to a home in Beloit.
ev: Flash flooding of small creek onto Ramsey Avenue, thereby blocking traffic. 1 foot or more of water in intersections of South 27th St. and Ramsey Ave., and South 27th St. and College Avenue. Storm sewers flooded with water coming out of manhole covers. Some cars stalled in flood waters.
lsr: 1 FOOT OR MORE OF WATER IN ROADWAY. SOCIAL MEDIA REPORT.
1 FOOT OR MORE OF WATER IN INTERSECTION. CARS STALLED. WATER COMING OUT OF HOLES IN MANHOLES ON THE STREET. RELAYED VIA SOCIAL MEDIA.
